entries.title: Psalms 115:1
segments: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 115:2
segments: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?

entries.title: Psalms 115:3
segments: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.

entries.title: Psalms 115:4
segments: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 115:5
segments: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

entries.title: Psalms 115:6
segments: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;

entries.title: Psalms 115:7
segments: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.

entries.title: Psalms 115:8
segments: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

entries.title: Psalms 115:9
segments: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:10
segments: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:11
segments: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:12
segments: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless [us]: He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

entries.title: Psalms 115:13
segments: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.

entries.title: Psalms 115:14
segments: Jehovah increase you more and more, You and your children.

entries.title: Psalms 115:15
segments: Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

entries.title: Psalms 115:16
segments: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 115:17
segments: The dead praise not Jehovah, Neither any that go down into silence;

entries.title: Psalms 115:18
segments: But we will bless Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.  Praise ye Jehovah.
